title: manni lint template file
description: A template file: named doctype templates, plus the reusable fragments they point at with `$ref`. Validated after dereferencing, so no `$ref` survives to be seen here. A template is itself a rule: it describes the page, and it takes every rule key plus `title`, `types` and `extends`.

$schema.description: URL of this schema, so an editor can offer completion. Read by editors, never by the linter.

info.description: Free-form metadata about the file (title, version, author). Never read by the linter; declared so a file that carries it is not rejected.

templates.description: The doctype templates this file defines, keyed by name.

components.description: Reusable fragments, targeted by `$ref` from elsewhere in the file. Left unconstrained: a fragment is validated where it is inlined, not where it is declared.

min.description: Fewest occurrences. Absent means one. Deliberately carries no JSON Schema `default`, and neither does any other key in this file: Ajv's `useDefaults` would write one in at load time, and a written-in value is indistinguishable from a value the author typed, so it wins the `extends` merge against the parent's real value. The code reads `undefined` instead.

max.description: Most occurrences. Absent is unbounded, so write `max: 1` for exactly once and `max: 0` to forbid. Must be at least `min` where both are written; the loader checks that, because JSON Schema cannot compare two siblings.

id.description: Handle for this rule, unique among its siblings. It appears in messages, and `extends` targets it to replace one inherited rule in place.

description.description: Prose description of what the rule is for. Never checked.

heading.description: The heading of the section this rule describes. Absent means any heading, or none. A string is exact text, a list is one-of, `{ pattern }` is an unanchored regular expression, and `false` means the section has no heading of its own.

attributes.description: Literal attributes the node must carry. A string is the required value; `true` requires the attribute to be present, and `false` requires it to be absent.

oneOfSequenceOrContains.description: A rule says what it holds in order (`sequence`) or in any order (`contains`), never both.

noHeadingOnRepeat.description: `repeat` groups sibling rules into one repeated unit, so the group has no heading of its own. Put the heading on the first rule inside it.

noInstructions.description: `instructions` was the language-model hook of doc-structure-lint. manni lint is deterministic and has no model, so a template carrying it is rejected outright rather than silently ignored; the loader turns this into a migration message pointing at manni docevals.

template.description: One doctype template. A template is a rule describing the page itself, so it takes every rule key, plus `title`, `types` and `extends`.

title.description: Human-readable name for the template, shown by `manni lint templates`.

types.description: Doctypes this template serves, matched against a page's `type` frontmatter.

extends.description: Template reference (built-in id, path, or URL, optionally with a `#name` fragment) whose rules this template inherits.

min.description: Refused on a template: a page is one page. Declared here only so the loader can say that in a sentence, rather than leaving Ajv to report an unexpected key.

max.description: Refused on a template, for the same reason as `min`.

rule.description: One rule. It describes a section of the page, or, with `repeat`, a run of sections matched as one unit.

rules.description: Rules for the subsections, in document order.

repeat.description: Rules matched in order as one unit, repeated by this rule's `min` and `max`.

sequence.description: What the section holds, in order. Each entry is one run of one content kind.

blockRules.description: Block rules, keyed by content kind. The key is plural because it carries a count: the node model says `codeBlock`, a template says `codeBlocks: { min: 1 }`.

counted.description: A block rule that only counts.

pattern.description: Unanchored regular expression every paragraph in the run must match.

language.description: Language every code block must be tagged with, as the node model spells it. A list is one-of: the block must declare one of them.

fenceInfo.description: Info-string tail after the language, where the format carries one.

ordered.description: Whether the list must be ordered. Absent accepts either.

listItems.description: Requirements applied to every item of every list in the run. Recurses arbitrarily deep.

variant.description: Which flavor of admonition. The node model's `variant`, not any one format's spelling.

alt.description: Alternative text the image must carry.

elements.description: Named-wrapper requirements. `sequence` and `contains` here describe what the element holds, which is never the enclosing section's content.

tag.description: The element's name, as an author of the format would write it. A list is one-of: an element counts when it carries any of them.
